sentences.text: Vedant Bhagat & Ors vs Unknown on 20 March, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
20.03.2023
Srimanta Ia No. : Cran/1/2023 in Crr/620/2023

In the matter of : Vedant Bhagat &
Ors.

Mr. Sandipan Ganguli, Sr. Adv., Mr. Dipanjan Dutt, Mr. Sushovit Dutt Majumder, Ms. Mini Agarwal
...for the petitioners.

Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee, Mr. Soumen Mohanty, Mr. Piyush Kumar Ray, Mr. Agnish Basu, Mr. Kush
Agarwal ...for the opposite parties.

Since the dispute between the parties emanated from a complaint under Sections 498A/406/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and other criminal cases being the offshoots of the said matrimonial dispute and in terms of a settlement submitted before the learned Additional District Judge at Alipore in a matrimonial suit for divorce between the parties.
It is ascertained that the parties have settled their disputes in full and final settlement of monetary consideration.
Therefore, the instant revision is admitted.
Mr. Ranabir Roychowdhury is requested to assist this Court on behalf of the State of West Bengal.
Learned Advocate-on-record for the petitioner is requested to serve the copy of the application to Mr. Roychowdhury.

Mr. Roychowdhury is requested to obtain a report from the local Police authority after ascertaining the fact as to whether the compromise has been effected by and between the parties voluntarily and without coercion, threat or undue influence.
Office is directed to incorporate CRAN/1/2023 with the record.
There shall be stay of impugned proceeding till the disposal of the instant revision.
The instant revision be listed under the same heading on 27th March, 2023.

( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
